items.title: What is included in Starter?
items.description: Starter is RM299 per month for a website and commerce setup with a customer support workspace. Final scope and usage allowances are agreed before activation.

items.title: What does Growth add?
items.description: Growth is RM399 per month and adds AI assistance to Starter. Supported channels, permissions and usage are confirmed for your setup.

items.title: Can I use my own domain?
items.description: Discuss your existing domain with us. Domain ownership, hosting, mailbox details and renewal terms are confirmed before paid activation.

items.title: Can I add modules later?
items.description: We can review additional modules and supported marketplace stores as your operation develops.

items.title: Are provider charges included?
items.description: Payment processing, messaging, AI and other third-party charges depend on the agreed setup. We confirm costs and usage boundaries with you.

items.title: How does the one-month trial work?
items.description: The trial uses a preview domain with agreed limits. It does not automatically charge you. Paid activation, domain and email are confirmed separately.

items.title: Can you review my existing website?
items.description: Share your current site and required workflows so we can assess content, catalogue and migration scope.

items.title: How do I get started?
items.description: Tell us about your business, products or services and the workflows you want to improve. We will walk through an appropriate setup.
